messages:
viv: quick update on Dedicated capacity: new gpu sku + region adjustments rolling out today.

viv: tl;dr: GH200-128GB available as Reserved Dedicated in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. H100 added to ap-southeast-2 as a warm/burst pool. KB: https://redwood.internal/dedicated/gh200-h100-march-launch

leo: perf short take? planning a canary for our doc-summarizer.

viv: GH200 shows best results for long-context (>=32k) and high-concurrency batching. H100 is better for mid-context throughput. perf/price table in KB.

ops-bot: [system] inventory snapshot: GH200-us-west-2: 18 units, GH200-eu-west-1: 10 units, H100-ap-southeast-2 (warm): 9 units. Live counts: /dedicated/inventory

maya: how should teams migrate? auto or manual?

viv: manual pin + canary recommended. use blueprint templates in Console -> Dedicated -> Blueprints. CLI quick-check:
```
rw dedicated check --region us-west-2 --gpu GH200 --model ./models/long-65k
```
returns AVAILABLE or FALLBACK.

tony: any new routing rules or fallback behavior?

viv: added routing policy "gpu_preference"; deterministic fallback chain: GH200 -> H100 -> A100-mix. can hard-pin to prevent fallback for SLA endpoints.

sales-bot: FYI pricing update pushed to Sales docs. GH200 reserved multiplier 1.85x vs A100 baseline; H100 burst pricing 1.5x. See KB for examples per 10M tokens.

leo: are hosted API customers affected?

viv: no automatic migration. hosted remains mixed pool. we will evaluate hosted H100/GH200 tiers separately.

ops-bot: [system] GH200 test cluster provisioning enabled. Request via /ops request gh200-test {team: <name>} (up to 3 seats).

maya: thanks, booking a slot to run our summarizer canary tomorrow. :rocket:

viv: thanks folks 44d will post follow-up with perf snapshots and exact KB links.
